$comment: A1 — the SELECTION table for named design directions. Distilled from F1 §5.0 + §4.2. Enough to CHOOSE a direction and to disambiguate a one-word brief. The full execution recipe for a direction (type/colour/shape/motion tokens, authentic-vs-cosplay markers) lives in docs/research/F1stylemovementsandvisualreference.md §5.1-5.20 and is pulled ON DEMAND for the ONE chosen direction — never all 20. Plan: docs/plans/2026-07-23-A1-named-directions.md

meta.why: F2: slop is the ABSENCE of a decision. A named direction is the decision. Owner ruling 2026-07-23: spend the budget on generation 1, because reruns collapse when the first set is genuinely creative.

hard_rules.one_or_two_max: Name exactly ONE direction, or exactly two with one explicitly dominant. Three or more on one surface is how output becomes incoherent. The second contributes exactly one accent move (a colour behaviour, a border treatment), never equal weight. [F1 §3.1, §3.9]
hard_rules.all_four_axes: A direction is a bet across type + colour + shape/space + motion TOGETHER. Changing only the palette while type, radius and motion stay generic is a re-skinned default — precisely the F2 failure. [F1 §3.5]
hard_rules.two_markers: Every direction has 2-3 authentic-vs-cosplay markers in its §5.x subsection. Hit AT LEAST TWO. Fewer is a signal to revisit the build, not ship it. [F1 §3.6]
hard_rules.no_adjectives_default: A brief with no adjectives at all defaults to Swiss-adjacent minimalism with editorial type discipline. Boldness is opt-in, NEVER a silent default. [F1 §3.15]
hard_rules.open_fonts_only: Every recommended typeface must be free/open with its licence stated. Helvetica, Univers, Akzidenz-Grotesk, Futura, Frutiger and the original Didot/Bodoni cuts are ALL commercial. Use the catalogue's named open substitute and say so. [F1 §3.11]
hard_rules.motion_character_first: Match motion CHARACTER to the direction's family before tuning any numbers. The milliseconds and easing curves are B1's. [F1 §3.10]
hard_rules.dark_mode_on_purpose: State which token carries the direction's identity in BOTH light and dark before building either. Skeuomorphism inverts to 'wet plastic'; brutalism's stark pairing needs a deliberate inversion; Swiss's single accent may need re-tuning. [F1 §3.4]

directions.name: Swiss / International Typographic
directions.key_failure: grid as an excuse for boring; multiple competing accents

directions.name: Editorial / Magazine
directions.signals: authored point of view, narrative credibility
directions.key_failure: big serif + white background with no real grid-breaking = costume
directions.avoid_for: transactional flows — narrative pacing fights task completion

directions.name: Brutalism (web)
directions.key_failure: incompetence mistaken for intent; broken a11y excused as 'raw'
directions.note: Forgoes conversion optimisation entirely — confirm that is acceptable.

directions.name: Neo-Brutalism
directions.best_when: consumer SaaS, creator tools, youth brands
directions.key_failure: inconsistent border/shadow application; low-contrast colour clash
directions.note: A distinct, more commercial grammar — NOT a softer synonym for brutalism.

directions.name: Minimalism
directions.key_failure: absence-of-decision; generic-SaaS sameness
directions.warning: The direction most easily faked. Minimalism WITHOUT a commitment IS the slop default (F2 §3.1).

directions.name: Maximalism
directions.key_failure: clutter — density without hierarchy

directions.name: Glassmorphism
directions.key_failure: text-on-glass contrast failure; over-applied visual noise
directions.a11y_note: HIGH RISK BY CONSTRUCTION. Verify WCAG 1.4.3 + 1.4.11 against the ACTUAL RENDERED background, not the mockup. Ship a solid fallback gated on prefers-reduced-transparency / forced-colors. [F1 §3.7]

directions.name: Neumorphism (Soft UI)
directions.key_failure: system-wide use fails contrast almost by construction
directions.a11y_note: Structurally cannot keep a reliable contrast path at system scale. Prefer claymorphism if the brief is 'soft/squishy'.

directions.name: Claymorphism
directions.key_failure: overused reads childish; shadow recipe applied inconsistently

directions.name: Skeuomorphism
directions.key_failure: bitmap texture perf; naive dark-mode inversion; embossed low-contrast text
directions.note: Confirm the domain has a REAL physical referent, or it reads as decoration.

directions.name: Retro / Terminal
directions.key_failure: any non-monospace slip breaks the illusion instantly

directions.name: Cyber / Technical
directions.key_failure: neon overused past 1-2 accents; readability sacrificed for atmosphere
directions.a11y_note: Neon-on-black is high-risk by construction — same verification as glassmorphism.

directions.name: Organic / Soft
directions.key_failure: Corporate-Memphis-style generic blob cliche

directions.name: Luxury / Premium
directions.key_failure: collapses into generic minimalism with no craft signal
directions.note: NOT a synonym for minimalism. It is minimalism PLUS art-directed (never stock) imagery, visible tracking/kerning discipline, and total restraint — one loose element breaks the illusion. [F1 §3.12]

directions.name: Playful
directions.key_failure: Corporate-Memphis drift; playfulness in a high-stakes moment

directions.name: Bauhaus / Geometric Modernism
directions.key_failure: 'colourful minimalism' with no real primitive-shape vocabulary

directions.name: Memphis / Postmodern
directions.key_failure: diluted into 'tasteful' colourful shapes — defeats the point

directions.name: Art Deco
directions.key_failure: gold applied without the symmetry discipline

directions.name: Y2K / Frutiger Aero
directions.key_failure: missing the specular-highlight 'shine' — the #1 tell

directions.name: Material / Dynamic-Adaptive
directions.key_failure: only colour tokens borrowed while shape and motion stay generic
directions.avoid_for: iOS-primary or brand-distinct products — reads as 'someone used a component library'

adjective_map.$comment: F1 §4.2. ORIGINAL SYNTHESIS in the source, not a canonical dictionary — a strong starting heuristic that must be confirmed with a second disambiguating reference (a competitor, an era, a real object). NEVER ship a direction chosen from one word alone.

entries.confuse_with: luxury — which adds the material/photographic warmth Swiss deliberately withholds
minimalism — which lacks the material quality that actually reads as expensive
Corporate Memphis drift — generic is not playful

entries.disambiguate: dystopian-elite console vs earned practitioner/CLI credibility — the pair most often confused
by decade AND mood: optimistic-glossy vs utilitarian-CLI. Do not default to Terminal just because 'retro' was said

entries.confuse_with: playful — organic is calmer and slower, not toy-energetic

entries.disambiguate: should the clash feel CURATED (maximalism) or DELIBERATELY WRONG (memphis)?

entries.followup_question: Modern like which of these — corporate, tech, luxury, editorial, or playful? Name a site or object you have in mind.
entries.disambiguate: UNDERSPECIFIED — all six read as 'modern' and look nothing alike. NEVER lock tokens from this word alone. [F1 §3.3, the most common brief-to-direction failure]

entries.confuse_with: confirm the domain has a real physical referent, or it reads as decoration

entries.note: Clay keeps a real contrast path; pure neumorphism structurally cannot. Neumorphism only for a single decorative control.

entries.disambiguate: THE HIGHEST-VALUE DISAMBIGUATION IN THE TABLE. Restrained and monochrome -> Swiss (a grid-and-typography discipline in black/white/one accent). Primary-coloured and foundational -> Bauhaus (circle/square/triangle primitives in a red/yellow/blue triad). A fintech dashboard wanting 'geometric and disciplined' almost always means Swiss.

entries.confuse_with: do not reach for this on a generic 'expensive tech' brief — see luxury

entries.note: Diluting the clash into 'tasteful' defeats it
Pure brutalism forgoes conversion optimisation entirely — confirm that is acceptable
The canonical two-direction hybrid: Swiss grid, luxury type. One structural grammar, one material register — do not let both compete for dominance.

no_adjectives_given.note: MECE-safe middle: Swiss-adjacent minimalism with editorial type discipline. Boldness is opt-in, never a silent default. [F1 §3.15]

on_demand_recipes.$comment: Deliberately NOT ingested. When a direction is chosen, pull ONLY that direction's subsection.
on_demand_recipes.why: Twenty full recipes loaded by default would recreate exactly the long-session degradation this whole architecture exists to prevent.
